context: Data visualization — hex-binned choropleth map of US population density using canvas for hex rendering and SVG overlay for state borders
first_impression: A clean US map outline with no hex data visible — the core population density encoding is entirely absent from the render
what_works: State border rendering is clean and well-weighted (thin internal borders, slightly heavier nation outline); typographic hierarchy between title, subtitle, and controls is thoughtful
what_doesnt: The hex bins drawn on canvas are completely invisible in the screenshot — the entire data layer fails to render, making the visualization unable to communicate its intended message. The color scale legend and all density data are absent, leaving only an empty map outline.
